request: Let users reset a forgotten password by receiving an email link that expires.
clarifications: Any user with a verified email address, including admins.
The link expires after 30 minutes and works only once.
[not sure]
After a reset, all other sessions for that user are signed out.
Accounts locked after 5 failed attempts unlock after 15 minutes.
Show the same message whether or not the email exists.

request: Let a manager export a team's task list to a CSV file for reporting.
clarifications: Only managers of that team, not team members.
Include the title, owner, status, due date, and time spent.
[skip]
Exports above 10,000 rows should run in the background and send an email when ready.
Dates should use the viewer's time zone.
Archived tasks are excluded unless the manager ticks a box.

request: Notify people when someone comments on a document they own or have commented on.
clarifications: Document owners and anyone who has already commented.
Mentions with @name notify that person even if they are not in those groups.
Notifications are sent in-app and by email, and users can turn email off.
[not sure]
Bundle several comments on the same document into one email per hour.
A user never gets a notification for their own comment.

request: Let a customer book a 30-minute appointment with a staff member from the available times.
clarifications: Customers who are signed in only.
Show times for the next 14 days.
A slot can be cancelled up to 24 hours before the start, with no fee.
The staff member's calendar and buffer time between appointments both block slots.
[skip]
Send a confirmation email with an ICS file attached.

request: Add filters to the product search page so shoppers can narrow results by price and rating.
clarifications: Price range with a minimum and maximum, plus rating from 1 to 5 stars.
Filters combine with AND, and the search text still applies.
Filter counts update as the shopper changes a filter.
[not sure]
On a phone, filters open in a bottom sheet.
The chosen filters are kept in the URL so a shared link shows the same results.

request: Let a workspace admin invite teammates by email and set their role when they join.
clarifications: Roles are admin, editor, and viewer.
An invite link expires after 7 days.
An admin can invite up to 50 people at once by pasting a list of emails.
[skip]
Invites to an email already in the workspace are rejected with a clear message.
Admins can revoke a pending invite.

request: Let field inspectors record checklist answers when the phone has no network, then sync later.
clarifications: Only the checklist answers and photos need to work offline.
Data is kept on the device until a sync succeeds.
If the same checklist was changed on the server, the newer edit wins and the other is kept as a copy.
[not sure]
The app shows how many items are waiting to sync.
Photos are compressed to under 1 MB before they are stored on the device.

request: Let users select several files in the file list and delete them together, with an undo option.
clarifications: Select with checkboxes, and a select-all option for the current page.
Deleted files go to a trash folder for 30 days.
[skip]
Undo is available for 10 seconds after the delete.
Files shared with other people are removed for those people too.
Deleting more than 500 files at once asks for a confirmation.
